confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by season and by beach-versus-centre location. Cocktail and wine anchors use general Chilean price levels relative to beer because direct local knowledge is limited. The FX observation comes from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page; figures for nearby dates in the same results conflicted, so verify against the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in mid-sized northern Chilean port and tourism cities such as Antofagasta and La Serena, adjusted for Iquique's beach and free-trade-zone tourism. Santiago prices were not used as a direct basis because they run higher.
